overreach.why: Điều 27 khoản 4 điểm đ requires scientific documentation for ad content beyond declared công dụng and tính năng. It does not allow content beyond khoản 2’s công dụng and tác dụng.

unsupported_paragraphs.paragraph_start: Children: dual consent from the child and the legal represen
unsupported_paragraphs.why: Điều 24 khoản 2 has the representative exercise the data subject’s rights, except cases under Điều 19 khoản 1, which is not in the anchor. It does not say the representative acts for the child for all other processing.
